id: title:Gilbert09:classify a bare botocore connection error as transient

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion worker resilience against transient object-store connection failures during bootstrapping.
review.reason: Adds transient error classification for botocore exceptions (ConnectionError, EndpointConnectionError) to the warehouse ingestion worker's transient error handling, allowing recovery from temporary connection failures rather than treating them as permanent failures. P1.F1.H2 adds the exception types to the transient classification; P1.F2.H1 adds documentation and a test case. This,
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and recovery path are not demonstrated, but the code change is substantive and bounded. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context or truncation. No score assigned as requested.

observations.behavior: Adds botocore.exceptions.ConnectionError and botocore.exceptions.EndpointConnectionError to the set of transient object-store errors recognized by the is_transient_object_store_error classifier.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog warehouse ingestion workers to recognize transient connection failures against their own bootstrapping object-store endpoints as transient, rather than treating them as permanent failures or customer-side issues.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation and a test case asserting that EndpointConnectionError is classified as transient.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and documentation for the new transient classification, specifically for cases where the warehouse worker cannot resolve or connect to its own local object-store endpoint during startup.
